CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_business_conversation_sender(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_recipient text, p_voice boolean)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare unavailable text[]:=array[]::text[];existing_identity boolean;chosen text;identities integer;thread_party text;has_thread boolean:=false; require_voice boolean:=p_voice;
begin
 if p_recipient is null or p_recipient!~'^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
  or not exists(select 1 from public.icash_screening_jobs s where s.id=p_screening and s.account_id=p_account)
  then return null;end if;
 if exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions where phone=p_recipient)
  or exists(select 1 from public.icash_webinar_phone_suppressions where phone=p_recipient)
  or exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions where contact_key=encode(sha256(convert_to(p_recipient,'UTF8')),'hex'))
  then return null;end if;

 -- An existing exact conversation wins before considering call history. Never
 -- hide a disabled or conflicting established identity by choosing a new one.
 select count(distinct t.sender),min(t.sender),min(t.party)
 into identities,chosen,thread_party
 from public.icash_non_test_text_threads t
 join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
 where t.account_id=p_account and d.screening_id=p_screening
  and t.recipient=p_recipient and t.retired_at is null;
 if identities>1 then return null;end if;
 has_thread:=identities=1;
 if not has_thread then
  -- Admission already saves the actual caller identity before provider work.
  -- Do not retry unknown outcomes through a different business number.
  select count(distinct history.sender),min(history.sender) into identities,chosen
  from (
   select r.from_phone sender from public.icash_call_recordings r
   where r.account_id=p_account and r.screening_id=p_screening and r.to_phone=p_recipient
   union all
   select c.business_phone sender from public.icash_customer_phone_calls c
   where c.account_id=p_account and c.screening_id=p_screening and c.recipient_phone=p_recipient
  ) history;
  if identities>1 then return null;end if;
 end if;

 -- owner_demo_call_capable_v1: retain the original call-now receipt as intent.
 -- Its expiry still controls final dial admission; this selector never renews it.
 if not p_voice and chosen is null
  and p_account='48dfb798-8c1a-404f-88c0-c396cc067062'::uuid
  and public.icash_outreach_voice_current(p_account)
  and exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_accounts a
   join public.icash_seller_intakes l on l.assigned_account=a.id and l.screening_id=p_screening
   join public.icash_seller_matches m on m.lead_id=l.id and m.account_id=a.id and m.screening_id=l.screening_id
   join public.icash_optin_call_requests r on r.lead_id=l.id and r.request_id=l.request_id and r.phone=l.phone
   where a.id=p_account and a.owner_user_id='592171a0-2bb9-484e-8c9a-dd5d2b43b5f7'::uuid
    and l.phone=p_recipient and l.state='assigned' and l.ai_consented
    and l.contact_consent_scope='icash_x_demo' and l.attribution->>'demoAccountId'=a.id::text
    and r.source='demo_form' and r.account_id=a.id and r.requested_by=a.owner_user_id
    and r.request_version='icash-optin-call-now-2026-10-16.1' and r.request_reference=r.request_version
  ) then require_voice:=true;end if;
 -- Check health only after deterministic selection, avoiding a health query
 -- for every number on the normal healthy path. Each rejected sender is removed
 -- from this bounded eligible pool; original identities are never reassigned.
 existing_identity:=chosen is not null;
 loop
 select s.phone into chosen from public.icash_text_senders s
 where (s.enabled or (p_voice and s.phone in ('+14154208230','+16195364770','+16462959838','+18623812530','+17866727869','+16462494809','+15056019451','+15055072937','+15127791343','+16027722055','+14357242174','+17262035755','+17262060050'))) and (chosen is null or s.phone=chosen)
  and (s.phone='+14243948384' or exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_business_voice_numbers n
   where n.phone=s.phone and n.phone in ('+14244377030','+17208134296','+14154208230','+16195364770','+16462959838','+18623812530','+17866727869','+16462494809','+15056019451','+15055072937','+15127791343','+16027722055','+14357242174','+17262035755','+17262060050')
    and n.forwarding_ready and ((n.outbound_enabled and n.caller_id_sid is not null)
    or (not require_voice and n.phone in ('+16462959838','+18623812530','+17866727869','+16462494809','+15056019451','+15055072937','+15127791343','+16027722055','+14357242174','+17262035755','+17262060050')))))
  and not (s.phone=any(unavailable))
  and not public.icash_text_role_conflict(s.phone,p_recipient)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_sms_routes route
   where route.sender=s.phone and route.recipient=p_recipient
    and (route.account_id<>p_account or route.needs_review))
  and not exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_non_test_text_threads t
   join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
   where t.sender=s.phone and t.recipient=p_recipient
    and (t.account_id<>p_account or (t.retired_at is null
     and case when has_thread then t.party<>thread_party else d.screening_id<>p_screening end)))
  -- A call-first pair belonging to another account is as binding as an SMS
  -- route. Keep its inbound account identity unambiguous before any text exists.
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_call_recordings r
   where r.from_phone=s.phone and r.to_phone=p_recipient and r.account_id<>p_account)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_customer_phone_calls c
   where c.business_phone=s.phone and c.recipient_phone=p_recipient and c.account_id<>p_account)
 order by encode(sha256(convert_to(p_account::text||':'||p_screening::text||':'||p_recipient||':'||s.phone,'UTF8')),'hex'),s.phone
 limit 1;
 exit when chosen is null or p_voice or existing_identity
  or icash_text_receipt_private.sender_opener_available(chosen);
 unavailable:=array_append(unavailable,chosen);chosen:=null;
 end loop;
 return chosen;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_recover_voice_configuration(p_agent text, p_config_hash text, p_observed_hash text, p_release text, p_checked_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare j record;n integer:=0;checked timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();capacity_snapshot jsonb;
begin
 if p_agent is null or p_agent !~ '^agent_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'
  or p_config_hash is null or p_config_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  or p_observed_hash is null or p_observed_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  or p_release is null or p_release !~ '^[a-f0-9]{40}$'
  or p_checked_at is null or p_checked_at>checked or p_checked_at<checked-interval '2 minutes' then return 0;end if;
 -- Same serialization boundary as dispatch, STOP and operation admission.
 perform 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 and enabled for update;
 if not found or not public.icash_outgoing_voice_capacity_open() then return 0;end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_production_template
  where id=1 and enabled and agent_id=p_agent and agent_config_hash=p_config_hash and reviewed_until>checked) then return 0;end if;
 capacity_snapshot:=icash_recording_private.voice_capacity_snapshot();
 for j in
  with busy_contacts as materialized (
   select distinct recipient.contact_key
   from public.icash_voice_jobs busy
   cross join lateral (
    select target.contact_key from public.icash_voice_contact_targets target
    where target.id=coalesce(busy.permission_id,busy.operational_contact_id)
     and target.account_id=busy.account_id offset 0
   ) recipient
   where busy.state in ('ready','issued','dispatching')
  )
  select candidate.* from (
   select v.*,target.contact_key,target.screening_id,t.id as ticket_id,
    (select max(r.recovered_at) from icash_recording_private.configuration_recoveries r where r.account_id=v.account_id) as last_recovered
   from public.icash_voice_jobs v
   join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=v.account_id and not a.bot_paused
   join public.icash_wallets w on w.account_id=a.id and w.balance_cents>w.reserved_cents
   join public.icash_voice_configs c on c.account_id=a.id and c.enabled and c.reviewed_until>checked
    and c.agent_id=p_agent and c.agent_config_hash=p_config_hash
   cross join lateral (
    select target.* from public.icash_voice_contact_targets target
    where target.id=coalesce(v.permission_id,v.operational_contact_id)
     and target.account_id=v.account_id and target.party='seller' and target.revoked_at is null and target.permission_until>checked
     and ((v.permission_id is not null and v.operational_contact_id is null and target.eligibility_source='operator_record')
      or (v.permission_id is null and v.operational_contact_id is not null and target.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))
    offset 0
   ) target
   join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=target.screening_id and s.account_id=v.account_id and s.state='complete'
    and s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
    and case when pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(s.snapshot->>'fetchedAt','timestamptz')
     then (s.snapshot->>'fetchedAt')::timestamptz between checked-interval '24 hours' and checked else false end
   join public.icash_automation_tickets t on t.voice_job_id=v.id and t.account_id=v.account_id and t.kind='voice_dispatch'
    and t.state='held' and t.outcome='production_agent_review_required' and t.completed_at is not null and t.completed_at<=p_checked_at
    and t.expires_at<=checked
   where v.state='held' and v.outcome='production_agent_review_required' and v.due_at<=checked and v.updated_at<=p_checked_at
    and v.operation_key is null and v.provider_call_sid is null and v.conversation_id is null
    -- Requested callbacks, SMS calls and Meta sequences have their own source
    -- expiry/recovery rules. Only ordinary first seller calls enter this repair.
    and v.callback_id is null and v.sms_source_message_id is null and v.cancellation_notice_id is null
    and v.meta_offer_lead_id is null and v.meta_retry_of is null and v.meta_followup_lead_id is null
    and not exists(select 1 from icash_recording_private.configuration_recoveries r where r.job_id=v.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets other where other.voice_job_id=v.id and other.id<>t.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o where o.operation_key='voice:'||v.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_call_recordings r where r.voice_job_id=v.id or r.operation_key='voice:'||v.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations l where l.operation_key='voice:'||v.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from busy_contacts busy where busy.contact_key=target.contact_key)
   order by last_recovered nulls first,v.created_at,v.id for update of v skip locked offset 0
  ) candidate
  where public.icash_membership_work_allowed(candidate.account_id)
   and public.icash_outreach_voice_current(candidate.account_id)
   and case when candidate.operational_contact_id is not null
    then public.icash_operational_contact_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.operational_contact_id,'voice',false)
    else public.icash_seller_voice_permission_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.permission_id) end
   and public.icash_voice_outreach_hours_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.id)
   and public.icash_seller_phone_call_current(candidate.account_id,candidate.id)
   and icash_recording_private.voice_capacity_from_snapshot(candidate.account_id,p_agent,'voice:'||candidate.id,candidate.contact_key,false,capacity_snapshot)
  limit 20
 loop
  -- A row visited earlier in this batch may have queued this same recipient.
  if exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs other
   cross join lateral (
    select target.contact_key from public.icash_voice_contact_targets target
    where target.id=coalesce(other.permission_id,other.operational_contact_id)
     and target.account_id=other.account_id offset 0
   ) recipient
   where other.id<>j.id and recipient.contact_key=j.contact_key and other.state in ('ready','issued','dispatching')) then continue;end if;
  update public.icash_voice_jobs set state='ready',outcome='Queued after verified calling configuration recovery',updated_at=checked where id=j.id;
  if not icash_recording_private.voice_queue_slot_from_snapshot(j.account_id,j.id,capacity_snapshot) then
   update public.icash_voice_jobs set state='held',outcome=j.outcome,updated_at=j.updated_at where id=j.id;
   continue;
  end if;
  insert into icash_recording_private.configuration_recoveries(job_id,account_id,ticket_id,previous_outcome,previous_updated_at,config_hash,observed_hash,release_sha,provider_checked_at)
   values(j.id,j.account_id,j.ticket_id,j.outcome,j.updated_at,p_config_hash,p_observed_hash,p_release,p_checked_at);
  n:=n+1;
 end loop;
 return n;
end $function$
